notes.title: Hexbound is officially live on Steam!
notes.content:
[p]You can now experience the full cozy puzzle experience—with new boards, quick play mode and lots of quality-of-life improvements based on demo feedback.[/p][p]- 40+ handcrafted boards
- A personal story told through letters
- Full game content + more to come post-launch![/p][p]If you enjoy the game, a review in the first 24 hours [i]really[/i] helps with visibility on Steam. And if you spot anything weird or buggy, feel free to ping me in the Discord channel - [url="https://discord.gg/bDKtj5dH47"]https://discord.gg/bDKtj5dH47[/url] [/p][p]I'll patch it up fast.[/p][p]Thank you all for the support! Time to get puzzling 
— Lorant / Sirius Gaming Studio[/p]

notes.title: Demo Soon!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm excited to share some great news—the demo for our cosy hexagonal puzzle game is coming very soon! I carefully crafted this demo to give you a taste of what's to come, featuring:

[list]
[*] Engaging puzzles set in a warm, inviting environment.
[*] Unique boards designed to challenge and relax your mind.
[*] A glimpse into the story through heartfelt letters from your distant friend.
[/list]

My goal is to create a calming yet intriguing puzzle experience, and your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the full game.

Stay tuned for more details, and be sure to wishlist the game if you haven't already!

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm. I can't wait for you to try it!
